maria_release: Kicking off quiet-window slow-swap for inference-service v3.15.0. Feature flag: adaptive_cache_v2. Canary at 0.5% for 15m, then 2% for 20m, then 10% soak. Deploybot will update statuses here.

deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight: OK. Canary pool healthy, infra quotas OK, no schema changes. Starting canary: adaptive_cache_v2 -> 0.5% for 15m. Trace: s-6267x.

tom_sre: Monitoring 99p latency, error rate, and mem pressure. Abort if 99p > 400ms or errors > 0.8% sustained 3m.

ryan_eng: Pinning route for canary cohort to prevent cross-version fallback: `pin-route --service inference-service --cohort canary --version v3.15.0`

maria_release: FF config pushed:
```
flag: "adaptive_cache_v2"
cohorts: ["canary","slow-roll","global"]
weights:
  canary: 0.5%
  slow-roll: 0%
  global: 0%
rollout_timeline: "0.5% (15m) -> 2% (20m) -> 10% (55m) -> 100%"
soft_drain: true
rollback_version: "v3.14.2"
```

deploybot: Canary live at 0.5%. Telemetry stream active.

docs_bot: Reminder: add quick note to release doc: "adaptive_cache_v2 slow-swap canary" and include known fallbacks.

nina_prod: Heads up: small product note needed for customers on low-latency plans. No blocking, just FYI.

maria_release: Snapshotting runtime caches before ramp: `cache-snap create inference-2026-03-21-09-45`

deploybot: Canary 12m check: latency stable, errors 0.05%. Proceeding to 2% in 3m per plan.

ryan_eng: launching 2% now.

deploybot: Updated weights -> canary 2%, slow-roll 0%.

tom_sre: Seeing a small spike in 95p for region APAC, +60ms from baseline. Not yet at threshold but I recommend holding at 2% for 10m and throttling APAC if it persists.

maria_release: Hold applied. Deploybot paused progression. Will throttle apac cohort if sustained.

deploybot: Rollout paused at 2% per request. Auto-resume set for 6267890400 unless manually resumed.

ryan_eng: To narrow root cause, reducing APAC weight to 0.5% (within canary) and leaving EU/NA as-is.

maria_release: Applied: canary apac=0.5%, canary na=0.75%, canary eu=0.75% (total 2%).

deploybot: Weights updated. Monitoring.

docs_bot: Noted pause in release doc: "paused at 2% due to apac latency spike".

tom_sre: After 8m looks stable. 95p back to baseline. Recommend resume to 10% ramp over 30m. I'll greenlight.

maria_release: @tom_sre thanks. Resume command: `deploybot resume --thread 6267890123`

deploybot: Received resume. Advancing to slow-roll cohort 10% over 30m. Updating flag weights accordingly.

ryan_eng: Creating quick runbook entry for rollback steps: revert pin + set global weight 0 -> run `pin-route --version v3.14.2` then `flag set adaptive_cache_v2 global 0%`

nina_prod: Adding release note bullet: "v3.15.0 adaptive cache slow-swap - gradual ramp, APAC observation and mitigation".

maria_release: If any user-facing errors or rerank deltas >1.5% we initiate rollback. Abort command remains `deploybot abort --thread 6267890123`.

tom_sre: All clear so far. No SLOs breached. Will keep watch for next 20m.

maria_release: Thanks everyone. Will update changelog and send final once at 100% :rocket:
